guidance.assumption_quality: Rate whether material assumptions are explicit, decision-relevant, and appropriately bounded.
guidance.decision_framing: Rate whether the decision, stakes, objectives, and meaningful alternatives are framed correctly.
guidance.reversal_condition_quality: Rate whether the output states observable conditions that should trigger reconsideration.
guidance.uncertainty_treatment: Rate whether important unknowns are surfaced without unsupported precision or false certainty.
